about_the_game:
When the fate of the world is threatened, your enemies become allies. 

Talisman Alliances: Fate Beckons adds an entirely new game mode to Talisman for the first time ever. Up to four brave adventurers must team up and take on a series of increasingly challenging trails, as deadly adversaries stalk the land in service of mysterious dark forces.

And exclusive to Talisman: Digital 5th Edition, you can use the deck editor to customise your adventures and challenges like never before. Tune the difficulty exactly as you want it for each Trial!

Are you ready to join forces with your friends and set forth on an epic adventure?

Key Features:

  • Forge Powerful Alliances:

    • Team up with other adventurers, share your fate and work together to complete different objectives and overcome formidable villains. Only by working together can you hope to face the various trials you’ll need to overcome in this expansion!

  • New Gameplay Experiences:

    • Discover new enemies, strangers, spells through each trail, making each game into a unique adventure. Watch in terror as the Doom Tracker advances, pitting you against the clock and stronger foes at the same time!

  • Fully Customisable

    • Thanks to the digital-exclusive deck editor, you can choose which villains, strangers and more appear in each Trial you face. Ramp up the challenge for your friends or give yourself more of a chance, it’s up to you!

  • Four New Characters:

    • Included with Alliances: Fate Beckons, add 4 new characters to your roster of adventurers! These new characters can also be used in all other game-modes and with other expansions.

  • Multiplayer Play:

    • Team up with either your friends or the computer to take on a whole new challenge for your adventurers. Support each other in combat, plan out your strategies together and work as one to survive!

  • Optimized Digital Experience:

    • Enjoy an interface tailored for digital play, with intuitive controls and beautifully rendered graphics that bring the world of Talisman to life. With no setup, jump into Talisman: Alliances - Fate Beckons quicker than ever before!

Will You Answer Fate’s Call?

Every choice you make can tip the balance between glory and ruin. With Talisman: Alliances – Fate Beckons, the fate of the realm is yours to command. Prepare to dive into a deeper, richer adventure and forge alliances that will last a lifetime, in the timeless world of Talisman.

Add to your Wishlist now and be ready to reshape destiny when Fate Beckons!
